jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager - Rokt Ads
jobs.description:
We are Rokt.
We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We've built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of ecommerce companies' ancillary revenue potential sits.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.

Target total compensation ranges from $233,000 - $308,000, including a fixed annual salary of $145,000 - $175,000 (including superannuation), target quarterly variable compensation, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

About the role:

Rokt is a unique performance marketing channel helping advertisers diversify spend away from legacy platforms. You'll drive advertiser demand across ANZ, securing new partnerships with brands looking to reach highly engaged audiences in the Transaction Moment. You'll need to understand the digital advertising ecosystem, navigate multi-stakeholder marketing organizations, and position Rokt as a serious, differentiated growth channel.

You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, running a high-volume outbound motion and multiple concurrent deal cycles. You'll multi-thread senior marketing and performance stakeholders, build in-market relationships through direct engagement and industry events, and hand off cleanly to Customer Success once deals close so new advertisers launch with a clear commercial and strategic brief.

We're looking for someone deeply curious, who leads with conviction and thrives when things move fast and change often.

We are an AI-first company.
We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn't obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won't like it here.

How your future team uses AI:

To research advertiser accounts before the first touch, building a view of a prospect's marketing spend, channel mix, and performance priorities without waiting on anyone. Outreach gets drafted against that research rather than a template, and agents keep pipeline hygiene, meeting notes, and next steps moving so selling time stays selling time. You'll build your own tooling for the repetitive parts of the cycle and treat a manual step done twice as a thing to automate.

Responsibilities

  • Own an advertiser demand revenue target and the entire sales cycle, from outbound prospecting to complex enterprise closes
  • Build and run a high-volume outbound pipeline, using AI-assisted research and sequencing while owning strategy and relationship-building yourself
  • Multi-thread senior stakeholder relationships within target advertiser organizations, from initial contact through to signed commercial agreement
  • Maintain consistent in-market presence: attend industry events and build relationships with advertiser and agency leadership
  • Own a named account territory plan, and run multiple active deal cycles concurrently with clear judgment on where to prioritize
  • Partner closely with Customer Success on handoff at close, so new advertisers move into launch with a clear brief
  • Lead with clear recommendations grounded in performance marketing expertise; don't present menus, present solutions
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Applied AI teams to represent advertiser feedback in the product roadmap
  • Continuously refine sales tactics and share best practices. We win as a team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in business development, sales, or a client-facing commercial role, with a track record of running complex deal cycles independently, ideally selling into performance marketing, adtech, or ecommerce buyers
  • Strong performance marketing fluency: able to discuss and problem-solve against ROAS/CPA, incrementality/attribution concepts, measurement design, and channel comparability with sophisticated teams
  • Excellent executive communication and presence: able to run high-stakes meetings, influence without authority, and create clarity across complex stakeholder groups
  • Proven judgment in prioritizing a high-volume pipeline across concurrent opportunities at different stages
  • Builder mindset and operational discipline: you proactively remove friction, create scalable playbooks, and thrive in a fast-changing environment
  • Comfortable using AI tooling to increase research and sequencing throughput, while owning the strategic and relationship-building work yourself
  • Willingness to be in the Sydney office at least 4 days per week and to travel for in-market client and industry engagement

About Rokt'stars:

We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

Benefits

  • Equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue
  • Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools, building AI fluency as a core skill
  • Monthly Wellness & Cell Phone Allowances, annual technology allowance
  • Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry
  • Quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don't wait
  • Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)
  • We believe we're better together. Most teams are in the office minimum 4 days per week

At Rokt, we choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing and keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, apply here, and you'll hear from our recruiting team.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager - Strategic Key Accounts
jobs.description:
We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability. 

Target total compensation ranges from $220,000 - $261,000, including a fixed annual salary of $139,000 - $170,000, inclusive of employer superannuation contributions, variable quarterly compensation, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

About the role: 

This role sits within our Strategic Key Accounts team in Sydney. You will report to our SVP, GM Commercial APAC. As a Strategic Account Manager, you will act as a quarterback across product development, commercial strategy, and project execution: driving measurable growth, expanding product adoption, and building durable executive relationships across a variety of complex, fast-moving e-commerce accounts. This is a high-impact, high-trust, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, uses AI as a force multiplier, and brings the organization, commercial acumen, and technical fluency required to keep multiple workstreams moving with precision while helping Rokt deepen its foothold across the full Transaction Moment™.

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.

How your future team uses AI: 

To stay genuinely expert on our partners' businesses. Earnings calls, leadership changes, shifting priorities: the team synthesises it continuously, so nobody walks into a QBR reconstructing what happened last quarter. That same intelligence surfaces growth opportunities and risks early, and sharpens account plans before they're presented rather than after.

AI also lets us see the whole portfolio at once. A strategy that works for one partner gets recognised as a pattern and applied to the next, and the commercial impact of a new placement or incentive gets modeled before it gets pitched. The administrative layer of the job runs itself, which is the point: more hours in front of clients, fewer in a spreadsheet.

How you will contribute: 

  • Own day-to-day strategic account management for your book of business, driving measurable growth, partner health, and expansion across multiple Rokt products.
  • Act as the quarterback across internal and external stakeholders, coordinating product, commercial, operational, and technical workstreams to ensure fast, precise execution.
  • Lead account planning and execution through disciplined use of Mutual Action Plans, Joint Business Plans, QBRs, and ongoing executive engagement.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including navigating high-pressure conversations with credibility, clarity, and commercial rigor.
  • Use data, structured analysis, and AI-enabled tools to identify growth opportunities, improve program management, accelerate decision-making, and continuously optimise account outcomes.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in client success, strategic account management, consulting, partnerships, or a related customer-facing commercial role in a fast-paced technology, ecommerce, media, ticketing, travel, payments, or adjacent environment.
  • Strong technical and commercial acumen, with the ability to lead sophisticated product conversations, interpret data, partner cross-functionally with Product / Ops / Solutions / GTM, and translate complexity into clear client-facing recommendations.
  • Exceptional organizational and program management skills, with a proven ability to run multiple concurrent workstreams, maintain high standards under pressure, and create better process and operating rhythm in ambiguous environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build trust with senior client stakeholders, influence cross-functional partners, and handle difficult or high-stakes conversations with composure.

Benefits

We leverage best-in-class technology and market-leading innovation in AI and ML, with all of that being underlined by building and maintaining a fantastic and inclusive culture where people can be their authentic selves, and offering a great list of perks and benefits to go with it:

  • Become a shareholder. Every Rokt'star gets equity in the company
  • Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Replit, etc) building AI fluency as a core skill, not a side project
  • Enjoy catered lunch every day and healthy snacks in the office.
  • Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)
  • See the world! We have offices in New York, Seattle, Sydney, Tokyo and London
  • We believe we're better together. We love spending time together and are in the office most days (teams are in the office minimum 4 days per week)

We at Rokt choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing & keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, apply here, and you'll hear from our recruiting team.

Rokt only contacts candidates from @rokt.com addresses. We never request payment, bank details, or identity documents before a written offer, and we never interview solely over chat apps. Verify any role at rokt.com/careers if you're unsure.

jobs.title: Senior Independent Sales Consultant - Rokt Ads, France (Independent Contractor)
jobs.description:
We are Rokt, a hyper-growth ecommerce leader. Rokt is the global leader in ecommerce, unlocking real-time relevance in the moment that matters most. Rokt’s AI Brain and ecommerce Network powers billions of transactions connecting hundreds of millions of customers, and is trusted to do this by the world’s leading companies.

Rokt is an AI-first company. We are a team of builders helping smart businesses find innovative ways to meet customer needs and generate incremental revenue. Leading companies drive 10-50% of additional revenue—and often all their profits—from the extra products or services they sell. This economic edge unleashes a world of possibilities for growth and innovation.

The Engagement

This is an independent contractor engagement, not a Rokt employment contract. The individual will operate through their own registered legal entity (e.g. EI, SASU, or société équivalente registered in France) and invoice Rokt for services rendered under a services agreement.

Requirements

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Independent Sales Consultant to accelerate Rokt Ads growth in the French market. This is a senior new business engagement focused on signing net-new Rokt Ads advertiser logos across market-leading French brands in ecommerce, retail, travel, finance, subscription, and consumer categories.

What You Will Deliver

  • Net-new Rokt Ads advertiser logos signed in France, delivered as contracted outcomes under the corresponding services agreement.
  • A high-quality pipeline of priority French advertiser opportunities, built and converted with commercial discipline.
  • Senior stakeholder engagement across marketing, ecommerce, digital, performance, and commercial functions at target brands.
  • Full ownership of discovery and pitch processes with market-leading French advertisers.
  • Market intelligence: French advertiser feedback, competitive signals, and go-to-market insights shared with the EMEA team.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in direct adtech, digital advertising, media, or performance marketing sales in France.
  • Proven track record of signing net-new logos with market-leading French brands, ideally in ecommerce or performance environments.
  • Native or near-native French fluency; strong professional English for collaboration with Rokt's global teams.
  • Deep understanding of the French advertiser landscape — ecommerce, retail, travel, finance, subscription, and consumer brands.
  • Strong commercial discipline: prospecting, pipeline management, forecasting, negotiation, and deal execution.
  • High ownership, resilience, and bias for action in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
  • Must operate as an independent contractor through your own registered French legal entity (EI, SASU, or equivalent), with the ability to invoice for services and manage your own fiscal and social charge obligations.
  • Prior experience working as an independent consultant or contractor is a plus.
  • Nice to have: experience in commerce media, retail media, affiliate marketing, customer acquisition, or AI-driven advertising solutions.

Benefits

Services fee: Monthly retainer commensurate with experience.

Performance incentive: additional compensation tied to net-new Rokt Ads advertiser logos signed, as set out in the services agreement.

Rokt will reimburse reasonable travel and out-of-pocket expenses incurred in connection with the engagement, where agreed in advance.

The retainer reflects the commercial nature of the engagement and is not linked to a fixed number of hours or working schedule.

Invoicing and payment terms will be set out in a mutually agreed upon services agreement.

This role is not eligible for equity, employee benefits, or paid leave.

This engagement does not constitute a Rokt employment relationship. The contractor determines their own working hours, methods, and location, provided agreed commercial outcomes are delivered, and is free to provide services to other clients on a non-exclusive basis.

An ideal CSD possesses a clear understanding of the partners' organization and their overall business strategy, and has frequent dialogue with key stakeholders. The CSM drives expansion of data-driven use cases and up-sells platform products and features. In order to do so, the CSM should possess the ability to understand a customer’s business needs & articulate the value of an enterprise platform to collect and connect data for consumer-focused initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative individual who works closely with mParticle’s Solutions, Sales & Product teams to provide client feedback and influence our product roadmap. Success in this role is defined by client retention, expansion and satisfaction
